the PACAP‐induced relaxation of the pig bladder neck is mediated via a VIP receptor subtype and a NO/cGMP‐dependent mechanism, and that the VIP‐induced relaxation involves a NO/cGMPI‐dependent mechanism and is mediated via a non‐VIP receptor.
